## Overview
Update git tag for DeepGEMM. 

The updated DeepGEMM (see https://github.com/vllm-project/DeepGEMM/pull/37) fixes build errors due to ambiguous calls in torch >= 2.14 (`bitwise_and`, `bitwise_or`, etc.). 

## Validation

Rebuilt vllm pointing to this commit with torch 2.14.1. It didn't work before the commit and is working now.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [ ] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@@ -17,7 +17,6 @@
     # _C_stable_libtorch, but these two modules still bind libtorch directly.
     "_C.abi3.so",
     "_rocm_C.abi3.so",
-    "third_party/deep_gemm/_C*.so",
 )

@@ -32,8 +32,8 @@ else()
   # Pinned to the fork's dev branch: upstream's 26/09/30 release (2.8.1)
   # plus the SM120 port, the SM90 paged-MQA kv_block=32/next_n=4 port,
   # configurable SwiGLU alpha/beta, SiTU for FP8/FP4 Mega MoE, and NVFP4
-  # Mega MoE. TORCH_LIBRARY build with a CPython 3.10 stable-ABI floor.
-  set(_DEEPGEMM_UPSTREAM_TAG "6ce1c5ec6627a6bf11dbcc698b0b1e19c9248432")
+  # Mega MoE. TORCH_STABLE_LIBRARY build with a CPython 3.10 stable-ABI floor.
+  set(_DEEPGEMM_UPSTREAM_TAG "a7a927731b109fdfec770df7c2a5be5d7e2216b5")
 
   set(_deepgemm_fc_root "${FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR}")
   if(NOT _deepgemm_fc_root)
